title: Cheque OCR System — Mobile Banking Integration
summary: Eliminated manual data entry bottlenecks in cheque processing by building a multi-model OCR pipeline using Google Cloud Vision, Azure Computer Vision, and custom vision models for mobile banking integration.
problem: Manual cheque data entry was slow, error-prone, and created significant processing bottlenecks. Existing off-the-shelf OCR solutions failed on Sri Lankan bank cheque formats, varying fonts, and handwriting styles.
solution: Built a 3-layer OCR pipeline: cloud APIs for initial extraction, custom vision models for domain-specific fields (amount in words, MICR code), and a reconciliation layer that cross-validates results across all three models.
achievements: Eliminated manual data entry bottlenecks across bank cheque processing workflows
Multi-model reconciliation approach handling diverse cheque formats and handwriting styles
Successfully integrated with mobile banking application via REST API
Handled MICR code extraction, amount parsing (numerical and words), and signature region detection

pipeline.title: Multi-Model OCR Strategy
pipeline.content: Stage 1: Google Cloud Vision API for initial layout and text detection. Stage 2: Azure Computer Vision for secondary extraction and confidence scoring. Stage 3: Custom vision model trained on Sri Lankan cheque dataset for MICR codes and handwritten amount fields. A reconciliation layer cross-validates outputs and picks the highest-confidence result per field.
